c74object.name: el.epluribus~
c74object.digest: Sample-level amplitude-sensitive signal selector and gate
c74object.description:
el.epluribus~ performs sample-accurate amplitude selection across multiple audio inputs. On every sample tick, it evaluates the absolute amplitude of all incoming signals and routes the sample with the largest absolute value to the first outlet, while outputting the inlet number (starting at 1) of the winning signal from the second outlet. When inverse mode is enabled, it passes the sample with the smallest absolute amplitude instead. This is useful for spectral filtering inside pfft~ subpatchers or for dynamic cross-synthesis and waveshaping in the time domain.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Audio Input 1 and control message inlet. Accepts the inverse message.
Inlets 2 to N (signal): Audio Inputs 2 through N to be compared (2 to 256 inputs, determined by the object argument, default: 2).
Outlets
Outlet 1 [Left Outlet] (signal): Selected sample value. Outputs the sample with the greatest absolute amplitude (or least, if inverse is active).
Outlet 2 [Right Outlet] (signal): Selected inlet index. Outputs an audio-rate signal indicating the inlet number (starting at 1) selected for each sample.

inlet.description: Receives audio Input 1 as well as control messages (inverse).
Additional audio input channels to be compared on a sample-by-sample basis.

outlet.description: Outputs the audio sample chosen from the winning inlet.
Outputs the 1-indexed inlet number chosen for the current sample.

objarg.name: inlet-count
objarg.description: The number of signal inputs to create (default: 2, range: 2 to 256).

method.name: inverse
method.description: When set to 1, selects the sample with the minimum absolute amplitude across all inputs. When set to 0 (default), selects the sample with the maximum absolute amplitude.

method.name: signal
method.description: Incoming audio signals to be evaluated at sample rate.
